_comment: Static league facts, money, and rules. Hand-authored — edit freely.
_setup_comment: Fill these in after creating the GitHub repo. `repo` powers meme submissions; the `giscus` block powers the chat board (see README > Chat board setup).

penalties.label: Last place
penalties.detail: Punishment TBD by the group chat. Traditionally humiliating.

format.seedingRule: Playoff seeding is by TOTAL POINTS SCORED across the regular season - not head-to-head record. Score every week or get left home.

rules.title: The Money
rules.body: Buy-in is $20, due before the draft. No pay, no play - your roster gets auto-drafted and benched until you settle up. Champion takes $120, runner-up $60, third place gets their $20 back. Everyone else funds the trophy.

rules.title: Playoff Seeding
rules.body: Top 4 teams make the playoffs, seeded by total points scored - not record. A 7-6 team that piled up points can outseed a 9-4 team that squeaked by. The lesson: there is no such thing as a meaningless Week 11.

rules.title: Roster & Lineups
rules.body: Standard PPR lineup: QB, 2x RB, 2x WR, TE, FLEX, D/ST, K, plus 7 bench and 1 IR slot. Set your lineup. Starting a player on bye is a personal problem and excellent group-chat content.

rules.title: Waivers & Trades
rules.body: Waivers run on the league's default ESPN schedule. All trades are subject to a league vote for collusion / lopsidedness - veto power exists but is meant for genuinely broken deals, not for salt.

rules.title: Activity
rules.body: Managers are expected to set lineups and stay engaged all season. Repeated abandoned lineups in a season you're eliminated from is grounds for replacement next year.

rules.title: Last Place
rules.body: The team that finishes 10th receives a punishment determined by league vote. It should be time-boxed, legal, safe, and thoroughly documented for the site.
